author: M4x1nator
body:
Alt IGN: EliteTeet
Primary IGN: M4x1nator

Banned for hacking and then my main was banned.

This is a relatively pointless and questionable ban. Basically I went on with an alt (EliteTeet) onto Avicus, with kill aura. I don't deny that. Turned it off after like 5 minutes. Quit out of Avicus, and then came back with my main account, M4x1nator, for fair play. No client, no nothing. And then that was banned for ban evading. First of all, I'd like to know how EliteTeet was supposedly found guilty of hacking when he was offline when the ban happened. Because I disconnected myself after I had turned off my kill aura for a good 5 minutes. Did someone record and then send footage to a mod? Or was I false banned when I ironically started to play legit on EliteTeet. I've donated to the server, been here a long time, since MC zone. I'm not a regular hacker, honestly just tried it out with my alt. I'm not a bad player or anything and I'd just like to be unbanned so I can continue to play legit... Keep my alt banned, I don't care, but I think that's the policy anyways. Again, never used kill aura with M4x1nator, just logged in on M4x1nator after I had used kill aura for a short bit with EliteTeet. If you guys could unban my main I'd be greatly appreciative.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned for Kill Aura, a Junior Mod recorded it and as they don't have ban permission, they pass the evidence on to Moderators. Ban Evasion is strictly against the rules, and it's your own fault for messing around. 
You will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
